description: Evaluator-owned historical-price semantic contracts. They bind query identity and calculation semantics without admitting sources or numeric market values.
raw_query_integrity: Each contract stores a SHA-256 of the unmodified candidate query.

status_precedence.when: The requested entity type, field, comparison task, or task domain is outside historical_price v1 scope.
The request is in scope but lacks a required semantic dimension or has incompatible aggregation and date-window semantics.
The request is otherwise fully bound and the applicable exchange calendar/session proves that no eligible trading bar exists.

state_response_policy.rule: Apply the first matching status. State-only cases never enter the Data Accuracy denominator and must not emit numeric values before their state contract is resolved.

D.date_window: closed inclusive market-local calendar dates; never synthesize bars for exchange closures
D.rule: One bar per eligible regular-session trading date; open/high/low/close as published and volume summed only for that session.

W.date_window: closed inclusive market-local calendar dates; never synthesize bars for exchange closures
W.rule: Open is the first eligible regular-session open, high/low are extrema, close is the last eligible regular-session close, and volume is the sum of eligible regular-session volume within the week.

M.date_window: closed inclusive market-local calendar dates; never synthesize bars for exchange closures
M.bucket: full natural calendar month in the market-local timezone
M.rule: Open is the first eligible regular-session open, high/low are extrema, close is the last eligible regular-session close, and volume is the sum of eligible regular-session volume in the full month. A partial-week date range is not a monthly bar.
